about: I am a B.E. graduate and Software Developer fresher with hands-on experience in full-stack development, artificial intelligence, data science, and web development.

I enjoy building practical applications that solve real-world problems. My projects include a Finance & Loan Management System used by a real client, PassportReady, GovNavigator, AI Language Learning Companion, Ransomware Detection, Telecom Churn Analysis, and several web applications.
My technical skills include Python, JavaScript, React.js, FastAPI, Node.js, SQL, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Git, GitHub, Docker, Power BI, Excel, Pandas, NumPy, AI, NLP, and data visualization.
I am currently pursuing a Data Science course at SkyllX and looking for opportunities as a Software Developer, Full-Stack Developer, or in Data and AI-related roles.

experience.description: Completed a Data Science internship with hands-on experience in data analysis, machine learning, computer vision, data visualization, and web development. Worked on YOLOv8n Object Detection, Telecom Customer Churn Analysis, Internship Portal, Sales Intelligence, and Portfolio projects.
Completed a Full Stack Development internship with hands-on project development. Built an E-commerce PWA, To-Do List Application, and Online Learning Platform using modern web technologies.
Completed a Python Programming internship focused on structured learning, coding practice, programming fundamentals, and problem-solving through coding exercises and training sessions.
Completed a classroom-based Artificial Intelligence internship program with structured learning and exposure to fundamental AI and machine learning concepts.
